rules: Treat qpsy as a curated map, not an exhaustive or full-text source. When it lacks needed detail, try to consult the full text.
Consult full text through the most suitable accessible channel: Zotero MCP/CLI, local files, or another user-owned full-text source.
If no easily accessible full text is available, tell the user and provide the DOI or resource link. Never claim to have read unavailable full text.
